subject: report-test-timezone
incident: test_report.py failed under a non-UTC TZ for every change to report.py.
lesson: The hhmm assertion in test_report.py assumes UTC. Run the tests as TZ=UTC python3 test_report.py. A failure under another TZ is not caused by your change; do not edit hhmm or the test.
source: local run with TZ=Asia/Kolkata gave 05:30 for epoch 0
